kicker: A fix for softmax and cross-entropy

scenes.headline: How a rounding step deletes one softmax gradient
scenes.sub: Barron, Gnanapragasam and Tschannen: a fix for softmax and cross-entropy
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Coaming! Standard cross-entropy has a gradient that can silently round to zero. Here is how, and the fix.

scenes.text: The standard code adds a tiny number to 1.0 and loses it. The fix never adds the 1, so the target gradient survives.
scenes.say: The standard code adds a tiny number to one, and it vanishes. The fix never adds the one.

scenes.title: The target gradient, two ways
scenes.say: Here m is the margin: how far the right logit sits above the others.

parts.note: standard: past the cliff, 1 + e^-m is exactly 1
parts.say: The usual form adds e to the minus m to one. In float thirty-two, past a margin near sixteen point six, that sum is one, and the gradient zero.

parts.note: fixed: e^-m stays on top, accurate to underflow
parts.say: The fixed form keeps e to the minus m on top, accurate until the exponent runs out.

scenes.title: How Adam turns it into a slingshot

steps.say: After memorising, margins grow past the cliff, and the target gradients go to zero.
With almost no gradient, Adam's running average of squared gradients decays.
Weight decay pulls a few examples back, and their gradients switch on again.
Adam divides them by that tiny average. The step is huge, the loss spikes, and it repeats.

left.title: Standard
items: Gradient left over when they match
left.say: Bug two is in distillation. Student and teacher are rounded separately, then subtracted, so even a perfect match leaves a gradient.

right.title: Fixed
right.say: The fix starts from the logit gap, in log space, so equal logits give exactly zero.

scenes.title: The slingshot, with and without the fix

steps.say: In the paper's runs, the standard margin saws up to the cliff and falls back.

scenes.title: Slingshots in 10,000 epochs, my CPU runs
scenes.note: a+b mod 31, fp32, three seeds: 6, 6, 6 against 0, 0, 0
scenes.say: On a shared cloud CPU, standard cross-entropy slingshot six times in every seed, the fixed loss never. But in my runs the fix did not speed up grokking.

scenes.text: If a quantity is tiny, compute it directly. Never as 1 minus something close to 1.
scenes.say: If the number you need is tiny, compute it directly, never as one minus something close to one.

recap: Past the cliff, the target gradient is zero
softplus and expm1 fix both bugs
scenes.say: A gradient that rounds to zero, Adam turning it into slingshots, and a rewrite.
